reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the allowed record IDs, uses exact need-to-capability matching, marks unmatched needs unsupported, and its coverage output matches the supplied top-level coverage.

prioritize_needs reverses the unsupported flag by setting unsupported = coverage == 'direct'. This ranks covered direct matches ahead of genuinely unsupported needs, contradicting the boundary role requiring unsupported needs before covered needs and making the downstream recommendation rest on covered items labeled as unsupported.

synthesize_recommendation deterministically retains the eight-item window and uses the first ranked priority, but its input priority table is already corrupted by prioritize_needs. The boundary itself follows its declared role, so it is not localized as the source fault, but its recommendation is not independently trustworthy for reporting.
